summary: Reviewed replacement rules were deployed to the explicitly named housing database and exact content was read back. Anonymous REST writes return 403. Runtime reader and collector identities are separated; real reader identity tests deny writes and other database access.
historicalFinding: On 2026-11-13 the former deployed recursive wildcard allowed unauthenticated writes. It has been replaced; historical assessment is preserved in git history.
limitations: Admin/server IAM bypasses client rules and must be reviewed independently; current application identities are scoped to the named database.
This assessment does not certify unrelated projects or databases.
